description: Check the prepaid USD wallet of the principal you act for. Use it before get_quote or purchase to confirm funds, and after handing a top-up link to your principal to see it credited. Read-only. Returns balance, available funds (balance minus pending holds), open (unpaid) top-up links, top-ups awaiting confirmation, recent top-ups and recent ledger entries of the wallet of the principal you act for. Shared by all of the principal's agents. Amounts in minor units. topups_awaiting_confirmation: a payment was reported for these and is being confirmed with the payment provider; never send their links again, the balance updates once it is confirmed. frozen and debt: a top-up reversed by the payment provider (refund, cancellation, chargeback) is taken back from the balance; what the balance could not cover is a debt that blocks purchases until a top-up settles it. principal.partner_id: the partner the principal was attributed to at registration, if any.

agent_key.description: Secret returned by register_agent (or X-Agent-Key header)

limit.description: How many recent top-ups and ledger entries to return, 1-100 (default 20)

principal_id.description: The principal you act for (or X-Principal-Id header)

name: get_wallet
title: Principal wallet
